ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels vs 25% low-intensity black/grey pixels concentrated in the central and peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity contiguous blob located at the medial-inferior region surrounding the notch. Secondary low-intensity banding along the trailing edge. Punctate low-intensity spots (mottling) scattered across the mid-medial and distal white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 50-60 degrees and high-depth penetration into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration map with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes; most pronounced in the mid-region of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally concave path from notch to tip, modulated by serrations; visible leading edge shows a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated 3D clusters of tan/white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal dark linear markings visible on the high-intensity white surface of the left lobe's medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive localized parasitic/epibiotic colonization (barnacles) causing structural irregularity at the distal extremities of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique punctate pigmentation distribution (black speckling) across the ventral surface of both fluke lobes.
